app: dryfit's menu bar app (widget and window) and its CLI
commits: conventional prefix, short lower-case sentence: `feat(menubar): …`, `fix(cli): …`, `docs: …`; see git log
changeset: a PR that changes what users get adds one (`npx changeset`, @dryfit/cli; patch for fixes, minor for features while 0.x); tests, docs and CI need none

surfaces.name: menu bar app
surfaces.ids: <section id> per state: m-… widget, w-… window, s-… sheets, d-… dialogs, f-… flows, n-… notifications; light and dark from the page's #th-l/#th-d switch
surfaces.scenes: LiveScenes in apps/menubar/Tests/DryfitMenuTests/LiveCapture.swift, one per state id, with the brief's fixture data

realWorld.how: scripts/newcomer.sh (a clean first run), then npm run test:integration

realWorld.when: the menu bar app talks to the daemon differently
